# TEAM ASTRANOVA #29

**Team Members:** PRUTHVIK SP, CHIRAG M, PRATHAM S

**Project: ORBITBASE NEXUS – Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer**

Our project is an interactive learning platform that helps students understand how astronauts can survive and operate on the Moon and Mars. It combines planetary exploration, space technology, mission simulations, resource management, a knowledge-based mission coach and quizzes to make space science engaging and practical.

**Our goal:** Inspire the next generation of space explorers through interactive learning and smart mission decisions.
details:
ORBITBASE NEXUS – Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

OrbitBase Nexus is an interactive educational website that helps students learn how astronauts could survive and operate on the Moon and Mars. It combines space science, technology and mission simulations to make learning engaging and practical.

Main features:

  • 🌍 Planet Explorer: Learn about Earth, the Moon and Mars.
  • 🛰️ Technology Atlas: Explore life support, oxygen generation, water recycling, power and food production.
  • 🚀 Mission Lab: Build a simulated outpost and manage its resources.
  • 🤖 Nexus Mission Coach: Get explanations through a built-in space-science knowledge base.
  • ☀️ Solar System Observatory: Explore an interactive model of the Solar System.
  • 🧑‍🚀 Mission Control: Experience mission phases and educational emergency scenarios.
  • 📝 Quiz and Debrief: Test your knowledge and review mission results.
  • 🌌 NASA Resources: Explore space-learning resources and NASA-related content.
